thread:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: svc-discovery/srv-lookup error spike in us-east-2a (alert: SRV-LOOKUP-3123). 95th/p99 failures on internal SRV queries to consul-proxy cluster. Impact: internal service discovery timed out, some API connections degraded.

Tasha (oncall): taking pager. looking.

Anil (sre): saw same. SRV queries to consul-proxy-azb returning 503 / connection reset. starting log capture and tcpdumps.

Mike (infra): any infra changes? no deploys in last 2 hours. cloud console shows peering flaps and egress errors: 'AZB egress NAT port exhaustion' flagged.

Tasha (oncall): copying logs ->
```
level=error msg=\"srv lookup failed\" srv=payments.internal err=\"504 Gateway Timeout\"
```

Jorge (netops): checking NAT gateways; nat-azb-02 shows SNAT port exhaustion and high ephemeral port usage. opening temporary SNAT pool resize and failover.

Sarah (prod): customer impact? which products affected? CS getting escalations for webhook failures and billing job retries.

Tasha (oncall): setting incident severity=high. standing up bridge. @sarah please confirm affected customer set and severity for external comms.

Sarah (prod): confirmed: enterprise billing webhook customers and a couple of background ingestion jobs affected. CS alerted.

Anil (sre): mitigation plan: 1) allocate extra SNAT IPs in us-east-2a (azb) temporarily, 2) restart consul-proxy pods in azb one-by-one to drop stale TCP, 3) scale CoreDNS in azb to absorb retry storm. executing now.

Mike (infra): running allocation: `cloudctl nat allocate --region us-east-2 --az azb --count 4` -> job started.

inc-bot: Job nat-allocate-3123 queued by mike (infra) -> started.

Tasha (oncall): restarting consul-proxy pods azb (rolling): instance-1 -> instance-2 -> instance-3. Doing one at a time.

Anil (sre): consul-proxy instance-2 restart finished -> SRV failure rate dropped from 94% to ~48% (p50 latency improving). continuing restarts.

Jorge (netops): NAT pool added. SNAT port metric dropped to baseline. moving to DNS scaling.

Mike (infra): scaling coredns from 3 -> 8 replicas in us-east-2a: `kubectl -n kube-system scale deploy/coredns --replicas=8` -> accepted.

Tasha (oncall): monitoring SRV success: p99 failures now ~3%. marking partial mitigation. notifying CS and bridge participants. :white_check_mark:

Sarah (prod): sending interim customer notification: temporary mitigation applied; we will follow up with a full RCA and timeline.

Anil (sre): preliminary root-cause: SNAT port exhaustion on azb NAT gateway causing TCP resets to consul-proxy, which cascaded into SRV lookup failures. Load amplification due to limited CoreDNS replicas amplified retries.

Tasha (oncall): follow-ups created: persistent SNAT capacity increase, SNAT exhaustion alerting, health-checks for consul-proxy, autoscale CoreDNS by DNS QPS.

Mike (infra): updated runbook: `runbook/snat/resize` with commands executed and timing.

inc-bot: Incident ticket INC-2026-3123 created. Severity: High -> Reduced to Partial as mitigations applied. Timeline and logs attached to ticket.

Tasha (oncall): closing active mitigation window. leaving notes for next oncall. tagging @anil @mike for postmortem items.

Anil (sre): I'll own RCA and runbook updates. assigning action items in tracker.

Sarah (prod): CS will follow up with affected customers with an incident summary and ETA for RCA.

Tasha (oncall): handoff to night oncall @david in 25m. bridge to stay open for async notes for 30m.

inc-bot: Bridge closed by Tasha (oncall).
